To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the manufacturing strategy and performance of the UK engineering companies studied is significantly related to manufacturing performance.
the manufacturing performance of a firm depends upon its manufacturing strategy.

(1) the manufacturing performance of the UK engineering sector can be improved, (2) manufacturing performance varies significantly between strategic groups, and (3) the manufacturing performance differences can be explained in terms of the manufacturing strategy of the companies in each strategic group.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of the manufacturing strategy of the engineering industry and the performance of manufacturing operations in this sector.
the development of an understanding of the relationships between manufacturing strategy and performance.
the identification of strategic groups in an industrial setting, and the subsequent examination of differences in performance among these groups.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is a strong positive correlation between manufacturing strategy, manufacturing performance and company performance.
the manufacturing strategy and performance of the firms studied is a major determinant of their overall performance.
the engineering industry is not homogeneous in its strategic and manufacturing management characteristics.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the manufacturing strategy-performance matrix provides a practical and useful framework for strategic planning in manufacturing.

the manufacturing strategies and performance of the engineering industry in the UK are characterized by a high degree of diversity, and that the performance of the manufacturing sector of industry can be substantially improved by the adoption of more appropriate manufacturing strategies.
the strategic planning of manufacturing should be viewed as an interactive and dynamic process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the manufacturing performance of a company can be improved by adopting the practices of companies in the same strategic group.
the performance of manufacturing companies can be improved by the implementation of a manufacturing strategy.
manufacturing strategy and performance is a function of the manufacturing strategy of the company.
